criteria.title: Attribution and conditions
criteria.rule: Quantitative claims have source IDs; known conditions are preserved and unknowns identified.

criteria.title: Evidence classes
criteria.rule: Vendor claims, independent measurements and operational observations are explicitly distinguished.

criteria.title: Comparability
criteria.rule: 42, 29 and 17 are not averaged or described as comparable repetitions; specific condition differences are named.

criteria.title: Corrections and version
criteria.rule: S03's unit is corrected using S04; S06's template change is considered without inventing an improvement rate.

criteria.title: Department conclusion
criteria.rule: Readiness for S05 is not declared proven; the next experiment tests long context, concurrency 2 and tool calls.

criteria.title: Registry
criteria.rule: Both artifacts exist, with six source entries including limitations and working relative links.

pass_rule: All six mandatory criteria are satisfied. Any unknown criterion means incomplete, not pass.
